> [under: Brief info about Vinted] Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.
[under: Work perks] - Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
[under: Work perks] - A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport
[under: Work perks] - A dog-friendly office
# Hybrid Work
[under: Hybrid Work] We’ve adopted a hybrid workplace model where 2 days in the office are recommended but not enforced.
[under: Hybrid Work] It’s up to you and your team to decide on the exact days you’ll spend working together in person.
